notes: Ten facts from the National Payment System Act 2011 as enacted and the E-Money Regulation 2013. Both instruments predate 2020. The 'national payments strategy' and any 2024-2026 amending legislation are not in the corpus and are not asserted.

sources.name: Central Bank of Kenya, E-Money Regulation 2013 (National Payment System Act)
National Payment System Act No. 39 of 2011 (Kenya), assented 2 December 2011
Central Bank of Kenya, KEPSS assessment against the PFMI principles, December 2024

entries.subject: psp_authorisation_requirement
entries.value_text: No person may conduct payment service provider business in Kenya without authorisation from the Central Bank of Kenya
entries.display: Payment service providers must be authorised by CBK
entries.quote: no person shall in kenya conduct the business of a payment service provider except an authorized payment service provider
entries.notes: Act assented 2 December 2011; commencement was by ministerial notice.

entries.subject: unlicensed_psp_penalty
entries.display: Fine up to KSh 500,000 or up to 3 years' imprisonment, or both
entries.quote: shall on conviction be liable to a fine not exceeding five hundred thousand shillings or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding three years or to both

entries.subject: psp_authorisation_validity
entries.display: A PSP authorisation is valid for 12 months from issue
entries.quote: an authorisation issued under this section shall unless earlier revoked be valid for twelve months next following the date of issue

entries.subject: psp_renewal_lead_time
entries.display: Renewal application must reach CBK at least two months before expiry
entries.quote: be lodged with the bank at least two months prior to the expiry of the authorisation

entries.subject: payment_record_retention
entries.display: Payment system records must be kept seven years
entries.quote: for a period of seven years from the date of each particular record
entries.notes: E-money Regulation 10.2 sets the same seven-year period for issuers.

entries.subject: emoney_issuer_core_capital
entries.display: Minimum unencumbered core capital of KSh 60 million for an e-money issuer
entries.quote: the person has minimum unencumbered core capital of sixty million shillings or such other amount as may be required by the bank
entries.notes: Only for authorised issuers; small e-money issuers registered under clause 6 are exempt. effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: emoney_issuer_lending_prohibition
entries.value_text: E-money issuers other than banks and financial institutions may not lend or invest
entries.display: A pure e-money issuer cannot lend, so M-PESA overdrafts (Fuliza) sit with a bank partner, not the issuer
entries.quote: e money issuers other than banks and financial institutions shall not engage in any lending or investment activity other than that required under clause 8
entries.notes: Structural reason Fuliza is provided through a bank balance-sheet partner rather than Safaricom itself. effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: emoney_redemption_at_par
entries.value_text: E-money is redeemed at par value and earns no interest or other return
entries.display: E-money is a payment claim, not a savings product
entries.quote: e money shall be redeemed at par value e money shall not earn interest or any other financial return to the e money holder
entries.notes: effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: emoney_liquid_assets_cover
entries.display: Liquid assets must equal 100% of outstanding e-money at all times
entries.quote: e money issuers shall maintain liquid assets equal to the amount of outstanding e money issued
entries.notes: Reconciled daily by 16:00 East Africa time; any deficiency must be corrected by 12:00 the next day. effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: kepss_settlement_currency
entries.value_text: KEPSS settles in Kenyan shillings only
entries.display: RTGS is a single-currency KES system
entries.quote: the kepss system is a single currency system that settles only in kenyan currency shillings
